==Trivia==
Oshy has the ability to give a Damage Boost to any unit you place <u>'''no matter where she is''' '''placed'''</u> on the map. (After evolving, she gets Cost Decrease Buff which decreases upgrade costs)
* This cannot stack with [[Blossom]] buff.
* Note that her normal version isn't limited. She's the first unit to do so.
* She is the first unit to have her banner version after debuting as a battlepass unit.
* If you see her on the banner, that isn't the limited version.
